handbookNote: Batch 2 (2026-08-16 directive): depth expansion of the tx_notary bank from 95 to ~206 questions, adding ~111 new, non-repetitive questions grounded in the SAME primary sources as batch 1 (temp/handbooks/tx/notary.txt) -- Texas Government Code Chapter 406 (Notary Public; Commissioner of Deeds, all of Subchapters A/B/C), Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code Chapter 121 (Acknowledgments and Proofs), Texas Government Code Chapter 603 (fee-book/posting/overcharging duties), and the secretary of state's own notary-education handbook page -- but drawn from statutory subsections, definitions, fee-schedule line items, and FAQ/glossary content that batch 1 had not yet used (e.g., the full Sec. 406.101 online-notary definitions list, the Sec. 406.009(d) good-cause grounds for discipline, the complete Sec. 406.024(a) fee table beyond the two items batch 1 covered, CPRC Sec. 121.006(b)'s six acknowledgment-capacity categories, Sec. 121.011/121.013 handwriting-proof and witness-subpoena mechanics, and the SOS glossary's jurat/affidavit/protest/verification definitions). Priced at $0.99, matching batch 1, since this remains education-only practice content under the same SB 693 status caveat -- no confirmed graded 'Notary Education Assessment' exists in enacted law or on the SOS site, so (as in batch 1) no question in this batch is written about assessment specifics; see tx_notary.json's handbookNote and temp/handbooks/tx/notary.txt's STATUS NOTE for the full caveat, which still applies unchanged to this batch.
